creatures.name: Glass eel
creatures.about: A long eel with a body like clear glass. Hunts in pairs.
creatures.look: A ripple in the water, then teeth.

abilities.name: Clear as water
abilities.effect: Sense rolls to spot it are Deep (16) until it bites.

creatures.tactics: Strikes from hiding at whoever is alone, flees when hurt badly.

creatures.name: Drowned choir
creatures.about: The drowned singers of the old cathedral, still singing.
creatures.look: Pale faces in the dark, mouths open, a sound like wet glass.

abilities.name: The song
abilities.effect: Once a round, every diver who hears it makes a Standard (12) Nerve roll or becomes Shaken.

creatures.tactics: Surrounds, sings, drags divers down. Falls silent if its choirmaster is shown the bell.

creatures.name: The Tidewarden
creatures.about: A guardian of glass and barnacle, made to keep the bell safe.
creatures.look: A tall knight of green glass, a blade made of moving water.

attacks.name: Undertow
attacks.effect: On a hit: Snared and pulled close.

abilities.name: Keeper
abilities.effect: Will not leave the bell chamber. Stops fighting anyone who rings the bell.

creatures.tactics: Guards the bell. Strikes the nearest diver; uses Undertow on anyone who runs.
